no_server: No Vinyl-Mind server is set. Enter the address of a server first.
url_invalid: The server address must start with https:// (http:// only for this computer itself).
url_parts: The server address must name a host and must not contain a user name, password, query or fragment.
recording: A recording is running. Vinyl-Mind waits until it has finished.
not_joined: This station is not connected to the Vinyl-Mind server set here.
already_joined: This station is already connected to this server. Use Reconnect to connect it with a new key.
switches_off: Turn on Contribute or Use the global model first.
leave_first: This station is connected to {url}. Disconnect from that server first.
key_changed: The server presented the key {got}, not the one expected ({want}). Nothing was sent.
server_key_changed: The server now presents another key ({got}). Nothing more is sent to it. Disconnect and connect again if its operator confirms the new key.
unreachable: The server {url} could not be reached: {error}
server_bad: The server's answer does not match the specification ({error}).
redirect: The server tried to redirect to another address. Vinyl-Mind does not follow redirects.
too_large: The server's answer is larger than {kb} KiB.
request_too_large: The request would be larger than {kb} KiB.
err_invitation_invalid: The invitation code is not valid (unknown, expired, used up or revoked).
err_invitation_required: This server only admits stations with an invitation code.
err_client_not_accepted: This server does not accept this version of vinyl-check. Please update vinyl-check; status and disconnecting keep working.
err_revoked: The server's operator has revoked this station. Connect again to join with a new key.
err_rate_limited: Too many requests. The server asks to wait a little.
err_join_limit: The server admits no more new stations today. Try again later; the invitation stays valid.
err_pending: The server's operator has not approved this station yet.
err_unknown_key: The server does not know this station (it left or was removed). Connect again.
err_stale: The server refused the request as too old or too new: check this computer's clock.
err_clock: The clock of this computer is about {s} seconds off from the server's. Correct the time and try again.
err_bad_signature: The server could not verify the request's signature.
err_replayed: The server saw this request before.
err_unsigned: The server expected a signed request.
err_malformed_signature: The server could not read the request's signature.
err_bad_client: The server could not read which program is calling.
err_binding_invalid: The server refused the sign-in: the confirmation from the account does not match this station. Connect again.
err_binding_required: The server needs the confirmation from the account for this invitation. Connect again with your account.
err_too_many_profiles: The server accepts no more turntable profiles from this station.
err_feature_version_not_accepted: The server does not combine this feature version.
err_detector_version_not_accepted: The server does not combine this detector version.
err_bad_profile_id: The server refused the profile ID.
err_too_large: The server refused the request as too large.
err_length_required: The server needs the length of the request.
err_not_found: The server does not know this.
acc_invalid_request: The account service could not process the request.
acc_invalid_grant: The sign-in could not be completed (the confirmation expired or does not belong to this station). Please start again.
acc_access_denied: The connection was declined on the website.
acc_authorization_pending: Waiting for the confirmation on the website.
acc_slow_down: The account service asks to wait a little longer.
acc_expired_token: The code expired before it was confirmed. Please start again.
acc_rate_limited: The account service is busy. Please try again in a moment.
no_accounts: This server has no account sign-in. Join with an invitation code instead.
connect_not_local: Signing in through the browser works only on the computer the station runs on. Use the code instead.
connect_expired: The sign-in took too long. Please start again.
connect_other_server: The account service named another server than the one set here. Nothing was sent.
connect_later: Signed in. The station could not join yet and tries again by itself: {error}
connect_later_recording: Signed in. The station joins as soon as the recording has finished.
connect_done: This station is now connected to Vinyl-Mind.
connect_pending: This station is connected and waits for the server's approval.
callback_unknown: This sign-in was not started by this station, has expired or was already completed. Start it again in vinyl-check if needed.
page_hint: You can close this tab and return to vinyl-check.
model_unsigned: The model is not signed as the specification requires. It was discarded.
model_wrong_key: The model is signed with another key ({fp}) than the accepted server key. It was discarded.
model_bad_signature: The model's signature is not valid. It was discarded.
model_invalid: The model does not match the specification ({error}). It was discarded.
version_mismatch: Feature version {got} does not match this station's feature version {want}.
detector_mismatch: Detector version {got} does not match this station's detector version {want}.
features_mismatch: The features or their shared scaling do not match feature version {version}.
nothing_yet: Nothing to contribute yet: no kind of event has a trained model (at least {min} real ones and {min} false alarms per kind).
not_checked_yet: Nothing to contribute yet: the model has to be cross-checked on at least {min} recordings with a master first.
profile_not_measured: Nothing to contribute: feature version {version} needs a measured turntable profile (chain noise, and an accepted alignment run with reference level and click floor).
package_type: The file is neither a Vinyl-Mind contribution nor a global model.

package_invalid.one: The file is not a valid Vinyl-Mind document: {error}
package_invalid.other: The file is not a valid Vinyl-Mind document: {error} ({n} problems)

package_own: This contribution comes from one of this station's own turntable profiles.
package_too_large: The file is larger than {kb} KiB.
package_json: The file is neither JSON nor a signed model.
